name: medical-s3-judgment-mini
description: Apply host-validated clinical research calculators and evidence-synthesis frameworks with explicit inputs, uncertainty, and verification.

# Research judgment

1. Use only a host-approved calculator or synthesis framework and its opaque
   input artifact identifier.
2. Verify input completeness, units, range, and applicability before relying
   on a result.
3. Distinguish a structured calculator or synthesis output from a diagnosis or
   treatment decision.
4. Preserve assumptions, uncertainty, and a validator receipt with the
   resulting artifact.
